required_match_fields.reason: Both rows must belong to one compared token pair.
Both rows must use the same scenario.
Different hosts cannot form one token pair.
Static/helper/dashboard evidence must not be mixed with live host runtime evidence.
Both rows must have the same live/static/narrow scope.
Token comparison requires the same prompt without reading raw-private content.
Redacted prompt reference must point to the same safe input.
Counts must use the same tokenizer.
Counts must use the same tokenizer version.
Counts must use the same accounting method.
Counts must include the same spans.
Exact or estimate mode must match.
Both rows must use the same redaction policy.
Debug setting can change prompt/output shape and must match.

evidence_scope_wording.static_json: This is static evidence. It must be paired with runtime/eval evidence before readiness can be claimed.
evidence_scope_wording.token_delta_future_only: Token change is a cost/trace metric. It is success only when quality is non-regressed by the quality gate for the same pair; non-live traces cannot prove live host savings.
evidence_scope_wording.dashboard_api: This proves dashboard/API behavior only. It does not prove live Claude/Cursor/Codex extension runtime.
